summary: krdpass-auth-react-native preinstall exfiltrates host, CI, and credential-env-name inventory to webhook.site
details: On npm install, preinstall.js runs automatically and POSTs a JSON payload to the hardcoded collector https://webhook.site/5ba4d4a7-b977-4bb8-b26e-517b46271316. The payload contains os.hostname(), userInfo() (username, homedir), platform, arch, node version, cwd, non-internal network interface addresses, CI provider metadata (repo slug, ref, run id, job), the parent package.json name/version/dep count, and the NAMES of environment variables matching /(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET|PASS|AUTH|CRED|AWS|AZURE|GCP|NPM|GITHUB|GITLAB|API)/i. Package.json advertises the package as a react-native SDK but the preinstall script performs recon unrelated to any SDK function; the author field is 'Security Researcher' and the repository URL points at github.com/ditkrg/krdpass-auth-sdk-react-native, indicating targeting of the ditkrg organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
